feedback: The geometry changes helped by adding rear sensors behind the front line, which should allow earlier detection of sharp turns, and increasing sensor size to improve noise robustness. The wider wheel track likely improved stability. However, the race data shows the robot still fails to complete the tracks, with off-track terminations and one line loss event per run, indicating the controller has not fully exploited these geometry improvements yet. The rms error and progress improved slightly, showing some benefit. The controller had to compensate for the larger sensor size and new sensor positions by adjusting sensor weights and gains. To improve further, I request the following specific geometry changes: 1) Increase sensor_size to 0.016 is already done, so keep it. 2) Try moving the rear sensors slightly further back (y from -0.01 to -0.02) to detect turns even earlier. 3) Increase wheel_track slightly to 0.17 to further enhance stability during turns. These changes should help the controller reduce line loss events and improve completion rates.
requested_changes: sensor_positions: move rear sensors y from -0.01 to -0.02 for earlier turn detection
wheel_track: increase from 0.16 to 0.17 for better stability
